run_harness_validation: run the python harness to validate a protobuf TestCase message piped via stdin
unpack_protobuf_any_message: unpack a protobuf Any message into its concrete message class using the unpack function
discover_protobuf_classes: discover all protobuf generated classes with a DESCRIPTOR attribute using inspect and class_list
validate_protobuf_message: validate a protobuf message instance using the protoc-gen-validate validator and handle ValidationFailed exceptions
parse_testcase_from_stdin: parse a serialized TestCase protobuf message from stdin and output a TestResult to stdout
